contextItems.text: The line 2 ovens are ageing: they limit output and use more gas per tonne than line 1.
Large retail customers ask for recyclable packaging on every product by 2026.
Rising summer temperatures and an irregular monsoon disturb wheat supply and raise cooling loads.

contextItems.needs: Effluent and air emission limits in the consent to operate are met and reported. These are compliance obligations.

contextItems.text: Employees and contract workers at the Pune Plant
contextItems.needs: A safe workplace, and a say in safety decisions through the safety committee.
Consistent quality, on-time delivery and allergen labelling that is always right. Contract quality terms become compliance obligations.

risks.description: All bakery-grade flour comes from one supplier; a failed delivery stops both lines.
Hot trays and oven doors are handled during each tray change.
risks.assessedWith: Two line 2 oven operators and the shift supervisor.

risks.description: Heat waves and a late monsoon cut wheat quality and push up cooling costs.
Rooftop solar at the Pune Plant would cut grid electricity and its cost.
Wash water carries fat and dough to the drain.
risks.impact: Organic load in the effluent sent to the municipal drain.
risks.significanceReason: The consent to operate sets effluent limits, so the board treats it as significant.

risks.description: Long hours at screens without breaks or adjustable seating.
risks.assessedWith: Two members of the sales team.

risks.description: Rejected packs and offcuts of laminated film go to landfill.

740bfa9d-f7a1-5022-9df5-77e4317a7e62.text: Two weeks of flour held as safety stock.

c12d28e3-1da7-55b0-9cca-3d1454dd4d04.text: Guard rails on the line 2 oven doors.

a0e2e8ae-021d-553a-ad88-867b252dd119.text: Grease trap and settling tank before the drain.

27b2e46b-7511-5a34-838b-0e0809dacd4a.text: Adjustable chairs and monitor arms at every desk.

objectives.text: Train every line 2 operator in safe oven handling
Cut grid electricity per tonne of product at the Pune Plant
Bring customer complaints down to five a quarter

d285c0af-b005-5634-8d4f-a148abe2cdb1.note: Line 1 heat recovery came on in August.

faedcc6a-26f7-5f92-85cd-40785de95092.note: Four complaints were about loose seals on one carton size.

actions.text: Add a reminder a week before each supplier re-evaluation is due.
Calibrate both scales and file the certificates.
Retrain the packing line on carton seal checks.
Put a glove station at every oven and check it each shift.
Fit guard rails on the line 2 oven doors.
Train every line 2 operator in safe oven handling.
Trial a compostable film for the snack packs.
actions.cancelReason: The trial film failed the seal tests.

actions.text: Trend complaints by product line each month.
actions.cancelReason: Covered by the quarterly data analysis activity.

actions.text: Replace line 2 trays with trays that have insulated handles.
actions.cancelReason: No supplier makes handled trays for these ovens; the guard rail covers the hazard.

actions.text: Retrain line 2 on the tray-change steps, with a sign-off per operator.
Add the climate risk to the three-year business plan.
Make every line 2 tray change a two-person task.
Move to a new carton supplier.
actions.cancelReason: The current supplier fixed the seal width at no cost.

actions.text: Budget for an audit of the second flour supplier.
Hire an energy consultant for the Pune Plant.
actions.cancelReason: The solar installer's energy survey covers it.

actions.resources: Trial batches on line 1; quality lab time.

actions.text: Fit a water meter on each washing line.
Install 150 kW of rooftop solar at the Pune Plant.

ncs.description: One batch of butter cookies was packed in cartons without the milk allergen warning.
ncs.containment: The batch was recalled from three distributors and held at the plant.

ncs.description: Water from the pantry spread into the corridor; nobody slipped.
Contract workers were not invited to the last two safety committee meetings.
ncs.containment: The contractor supervisor joins the November committee meeting.
ncs.correction: Minutes of the last two meetings shared with the contract workers.
ncs.rootCause: The committee invitation list was built from the payroll, which leaves out contract workers.
ncs.similarOccurrences: The Bengaluru Office has no contract workers; no other list is built this way.

ncs.description: The September evacuation drill took nine minutes against a five-minute target.
ncs.cancelReason: The time included a planned hold at the assembly point; the evacuation itself took four minutes.

ncs.description: Line 2 tray changes rely on gloves alone; no engineering control was considered.
ncs.containment: Two people now do each tray change until a control is chosen.
ncs.correction: Guard rail on the line 2 oven doors brought forward.
ncs.rootCause: The hazard review did not ask which level of the hierarchy each control was at.
ncs.similarOccurrences: The same gap may exist for the fryer; it is in the next hazard review.

ncs.description: An oven tray was moved by hand without heat-resistant gloves during a tray change on line 2.
ncs.containment: Line 2 tray changes stopped until gloves were at every oven.
ncs.correction: Gloves put at each oven; the shift briefed the same day.
ncs.rootCause: Gloves were kept in a store away from the ovens, and the tray change was rushed at shift end.
ncs.similarOccurrences: Line 1 has the same layout; gloves were moved there too.
ncs.riskReview: The oven hazard was re-rated after the incident and a guard rail added.
ncs.systemChange: Tray changes added to the line 2 work instruction.

ncs.description: Calibration records for two packing-line scales could not be found.
ncs.containment: Both scales checked against test weights; results since the last record were checked and held.
ncs.correction: Both scales calibrated by an accredited laboratory.
ncs.rootCause: Calibration was tracked in a personal spreadsheet that was not handed over.
ncs.similarOccurrences: Checked every instrument at both units; no other gaps.
ncs.riskReview: None needed: calibration is now a recurring activity.
ncs.systemChange: Calibration moved into the activity register with reminders.
ncs.effectivenessNote: Two quarterly calibrations since were on time with records filed.
